How it works
  1. Choose Restore detail to sharpen an area, or Edit with a prompt to change or remove something.
  2. Select the area: drag a Box, or draw round it freehand with the Lasso.
  3. Press the button. Only your selection changes; it’s lined up, colour-matched and blended back in, and the rest of the picture stays exactly as it was.
Editing fix 1

Backup
Your history lives inside this browser. A backup saves everything (all projects, pictures, tiles, fixes and their versions, and your settings) in one file you can keep safe, or open in Portals on another computer or browser.

Spending

Portals keeps a running estimate of every paid run, worked out from each company’s published prices. It can’t see your real balance, so check the billing pages now and then. Set a budget (or the credit you added) to see how much is left.
